desc: Choose algorithm: two-parity multi-source BFS on N^2 pair states with bitset transition generation.

Implement the complete Python program that parses the matrix, builds in/out bitsets, runs separate even and odd multi-source BFSes over pair states, takes the elementwise minimum, and prints -1 for unreachable.
Verify the implementation on samples and edge cases (N=1, no edges, self-loops, dense all-same-label) for correctness and performance.
